All deliverables are in place. Final summary:

**Dataset:** DANDI 000128 (MC_Maze, monkey Jenkins, Churchland/Shenoy lab) — streamed via `remfile`, 182 M1/PMd units and 1 kHz hand kinematics over 789 successful no-barrier center-out reaches.

**Findings:**
- **Cosine direction tuning** is ubiquitous: median bin-mean cosine R² = 0.67; 127/182 units have R² > 0.5; preferred directions span the full circle.
- **Speed tuning** is real but smaller: most within-direction speed-rate correlations fall in [−0.2, +0.2], with ~14 units modulating strongly.
- **NeMoS Poisson `PopulationGLM`** confirms direction + speed beats either alone (median pseudo-R² 0.119 vs 0.111 dir-only vs 0.018 speed-only).

**Deliverables in `/Users/bdichter/dev/agent-foundational-studies/runs-2026-04-27/reach-01/`:**
- `reach_tuning.py` (jupytext, runs end-to-end)
